## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

## Functional specifications
On provider removal stop that Person's channel and thread executions, including workers/stream processing; other people remain unaffected. Retain ordinary grant checks for all entry points. Manual history grants survive. Test active execution termination, idle runtime cleanup, exact-incarnation protection and no continued local stream output; already completed external effects are outside rollback guarantees.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/agent/server_manager.ex; executor.ex; request_registry.ex; runtime/stream worker lifecycle tests

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing incarnation-fenced runtime termination through NodeRouter and owner nodes. No membership leases or separate ACL. Ordinary grants still authorize non-channel entry points.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/{agent,channels}.md

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.32. No commit/push authorization is implied.

## Alignment update — 2026-10-07 / a0c8796e
Use Permissions and exact actor/scope/incarnation, not observed participants or literal-owner lists, as the authorization boundary. Merge ownership changes do not transfer runtime credentials implicitly; keep manual grants and unrelated runtimes intact.

Preserve baseline contracts and committed test suites in zaq-emb.30; extend coverage rather than duplicating it. Tests precede production changes; no status change or completion is asserted. Dependencies: .30 and existing .6 membership machinery; .16 is no longer a prerequisite to start .7. Independent .7 and .16 join at .31 to verify both lifecycle and context guarantees.

comments.text: Started seam audit after .16 completion (6ffd8c31), no .7 source edits/tests yet. Actual owners: Engine.ChannelHistoryMembership.refresh/2, refresh_person/3 and apply_event/1 reconcile provider-source grants inside transactions; reconcile/4 currently returns :ok and public results remain members/rooms or applied/stale. Manual grants independent. RefreshChannelHistoryMembership Action already validates current super_admin and should remain shared refresh boundary; do not duplicate it or change provider normalization. Need extend post-commit removal notification through NodeRouter.dispatch_all/1 to Agent owner nodes; never terminate on rollback, unsupported snapshot, stale event or surviving membership. Existing event wiring .18 stays deferred. ServerManager currently retains per-incarnation canonical cursor vector but no durable Person binding after lease completion; add an explicit trusted identity/transcript binding rather than parsing scope names or treating observed participants as authorization. Reuse exact-PID stop_server_if_current semantics. Killing Jido alone is insufficient: Api finalization currently permits delivery of handled outcomes after stream terminalization; buffered StreamEvents/local delivery and consumer workers must also be fenced, and cancelled root persistence must remain failed/private rather than produce a fallback public answer. Preserve post-removal restart through ordinary Permissions (manual grants survive), unrelated people/scopes, exact-incarnation replacement safety and completed external effects. Tests first at real configured/Jido + actual refresh/event transaction paths; mock only provider/LLM. Read Channels/Agent policy; Engine guide required before changing membership/API domain. No product decision outstanding; detailed notification/control contract and regression package next. .7 in_progress, .8/.31 pending; no push/merge.

title: [zaq-emb.7] Stop person-bound channel and thread runtimes on removal
